chapter: Jelly Roll, Boyman Ham and piano players
title: Jelly Roll's travels
summary: Jelly Roll did not stay long in New Orleans and traveled to the country for gambling games.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Is there anything more you were going to tell about Jelly Roll? When did he leave here? Did he stay around long, do you remember? He didn't stay here, I don't think.

Well, he stayed around a while, but he's a fellow who's always traveling out. He'd go out to countries like that. He'd go out to countries like that. He'd go around on excursions and things. He'd go out to countries like that and go around and have a piano and things. He'd go around gambling games and things.
Yeah. Mm-hmm. Did he play at Lula sometime too? All of those houses, I guess, he played at times, did he? Later?
Well, I don't remember him, Mr. Bell, playing for Lula.
